name: Temporal Loop
description: You walk the same corridor and find yourself walking it again. The Etheric field has caught the moment in a fold.
effect: Lose 1d6 hours of forward progress; risk of disorientation roll.

name: Spatial Distortion
description: Distance unspools. A chamber thirty paces wide becomes thirty paces deep, then thirty paces tall. The geometry refuses to settle.
effect: Navigation impossible while inside. Wits check or be relocated.

name: Etheric Storm Burst
description: A localized burst of pure Aether discharge. Reality buckles for a moment.
effect: 1d10 Aetheric damage to all in close range; technology may be temporarily disabled.

name: Tartarian Trap
description: A pressure plate older than recorded history triggers. Walls shift, floor opens, energy lances strike.
effect: Random effect: collapsing floor, energy lance, intruder identification ping.

name: Aetherstone Seal
description: Hardened Aether-mud, stronger than stone. No standard tool will pierce it.
effect: Blocks access to a chamber until Mold Ether or specialized relic is used.

name: Magnetic Distortion
description: Compasses spin. Iron-cored gear stops working. The ground tugs at every buckle and bracket.
effect: All electronic / iron equipment disabled while in the zone.

name: Flooded Tunnel
description: Standing water laced with Aether residue. Things move beneath the surface.
effect: Swim check; risk of aquatic creature encounter.

name: Corrupted Spores
description: A cloud of pale spores released from a fungal bloom on Aetherstone.
effect: Inhalation check; on fail, gain 1d6 Corruption.

name: Reality Fracture
description: A jagged seam in the air where the world simply ends. Something is visible on the other side.
effect: Sanity check; on critical fail, glimpse of pre-flood Tartaria (or worse).

name: Aether Mist
description: A glowing low mist that pulses with each heartbeat — yours, or something else's.
effect: Slow movement, gradual Aether exposure (build up Corruption over time).

name: Awakening Defenses
description: Dormant Tartarian sentinels register your heat signature. Old gears begin to grind.
effect: Triggers a Sentinel / Etheric Guardian encounter.
